Before you choose.

What can I try for free?
The two starting-point offers are a diet plan and a guided fitness assessment. Their working entry links, eligibility and any account requirement are still being confirmed. This preview does not generate a plan or assess your movement.
Is there a monthly payment option?
This preview shows ₹7,999/year. Equivalent to ₹666.58/month, billed annually. The monthly equivalent is a comparison, not an available monthly payment option.
How is Pro different from the free starting points?
Pro is positioned around personalised plans and deeper insights. The exact differences in ongoing meal planning, training features, daily insights and CGM analysis must be confirmed before you subscribe.
Are professional consultations included?
Professional care is optional and purchased separately. Explore the service details for the consultations and follow-up you need.
Where can I subscribe?
The intended route is plan selection in Orb. Its approved destination and the final tax, renewal and cancellation details are not connected to this preview.
